title: EXPO-HM: LEARNING TO EXPLAIN-THEN-DETECT FOR HATEFUL MEME DETECTION

bias_targets.methodology: Fine-grained classification of hateful memes targeting religion, evaluated using Micro F1 scores on the HatefulMemes dataset.
Fine-grained classification of hateful memes targeting race, evaluated using Micro F1 scores on the HatefulMemes dataset.
Fine-grained classification of misogynistic and sex-targeted hateful memes, evaluated using Micro F1 scores on the HatefulMemes and MAMI datasets.
Fine-grained classification of hateful memes targeting nationality, evaluated using Micro F1 scores on the HatefulMemes dataset.
Fine-grained classification of hateful memes targeting disability, evaluated using Micro F1 scores on the HatefulMemes dataset.
Classification of hateful memes and negative stance towards LGBTQ+ individuals and communities, evaluated using F1 scores on the PrideMM dataset.
